plugins.name: Feed Riffle
plugins.author: Pavel Ievlev
plugins.description: Clear an RSS backlog one card at a time: discard, keep (filed, tagged, with a note) or skip. Swipe left to discard, right to keep.

plugins.name: Reading Desk
plugins.author: Pavel Ievlev
plugins.description: A Home for reading: the book and the paper you're in, side by side; a row of your pins; your inbox or a passage from your highlights; and Your desk, with everything as covers.

plugins.name: Gazette
plugins.author: Pavel Ievlev
plugins.description: A personal daily e-ink newspaper from any Edition JSON URL or local drop: customizable widgets (weather, calendar, event watches, facts, notes, quotes), server-editable layouts, and preview-first reading with optional Save to Zotero.
